Privacy Policy

Selected documents and generated outputs are processed in working browser memory. These tools do not upload them to a document-processing server or keep a document database. Clearing a tool, switching pages or closing the tab releases the app’s references. Downloads stay wherever you save them.

The site currently includes no advertising SDKs, analytics or tracking cookies in its application code. The hosting provider receives normal page requests and connection information. File pickers may offer cloud services governed by their own terms. If advertising or analytics is added, this notice and any required consent controls must be updated before activation.
